metadata.title: Five Materials That Could Unlock 5–12 GtCO₂/Year
metadata.deck: A compact, auditable record of the article’s claims, source figures, data, methods, and institutional responsibility.

summary.claim: The draft article proposes that five climate-relevant material classes share a defect-mediated prediction problem and may benefit from correction of systematic model error.
summary.scope: Draft portfolio thesis; this pack does not independently verify the aggregate impact range, target thresholds, or internal blind-prediction result.
limitations: Impact ranges are conditional scenarios, not deployment forecasts.
Commercial outcomes depend on scale-up, policy, and partner validation beyond this evidence record.
The aggregate impact range, target thresholds, and internal blind-prediction result remain needs-verification.
summary.lead: This pack preserves a draft portfolio thesis and its selected figures without upgrading article-level scenarios or internal results into verified facts.

findings.label: Scenario
findings.text: The draft article reports a combined climate opportunity range; this pack retains it as needs-verification, not as a forecast.

findings.label: Prior art
findings.text: Peer-reviewed literature supports systematic softening of universal potentials away from equilibrium.

findings.label: Boundary
findings.text: The portfolio values and internal result are not independently reproduced by this pack.

summary.verdictDetail: Open pending independent review and reproduction.
summary.verdictBody: The cited sources provide background context but do not independently establish every aggregate, threshold, or internal result carried by the draft article.
summary.orientation: The following pages preserve representative article figures with captions, a compact data table, the methodology note, credits, and a bibliography. Figure numbering and source lines remain stable between builds.

methodology.description: Claims are selected from the draft article's explicit statements, byte-pinned, and kept separate from background bibliography when the cited sources do not independently establish them.
steps: Identify decision-relevant quantitative claims in the article.
Select figures that preserve complete axes, labels, legends, and annotations.
Copy values without reinterpretation; state transformations and exclusions.
Map an artifact to a bibliography entry only when that source independently establishes the artifact's claim; otherwise retain an empty source list and needs-verification label.
methodology.unitOfAnalysis: Material class and defect-mediated performance metric
methodology.versioning: Deterministic HTML/CSS build; source URL and document ID printed on cover
methodology.limitations: Impact ranges are conditional scenarios; commercial outcomes are not guaranteed.
transformations: None; values are copied as stated and are not independently inferred.
